title: Correlation register — officially sourced numbers only
description: Every value in this register is computed from rows transcribed from official league sources (S01/S03/S52), and every value publishes its n alongside it. Correlations computed from third-party captures are excluded by rule (engine/corr_official.py refuses non-official source ids) and remain on their own labelled pages.

excluded_registers.why: computed from the third-party nflverse games capture (S47)

computed from third-party closing prices; self-labelled unverified

method: Pearson r; Fisher-z 95% CI; n published with every value

rows.label: Season point differential per game vs win percentage
rows.method: Pearson r over game/team-level rows; Fisher-z 95% CI

rows.method: Pearson r over game/team-level rows; Fisher-z 95% CI
